name: npr-test_render_info_sampling
purpose: Verify Render Info sample outputs in an Eevee render and compile the direct Current Sample to White Noise W workflow.
passCriteria: With four Eevee render samples, Current Sample must accumulate close to the average of 0,1,2,3; Total Samples must render close to 4; and a material linking Current Sample to White Noise Texture W must compile and produce a finite rendered value.
